name: B-Side
description: Control AIMP from Orca — your lossless collection while you work

cover.alt: B-Side logo, the words "Your music library, inside Orca" and two panels: the Albums grid of a demo library and Now Playing with synced lyrics

screenshots.alt: The panel dragged wide: a demo Albums grid on the left, Now Playing on the right with cover, format badges, synced lyrics and controls
screenshots.caption: Browse your collection beside what is playing

screenshots.alt: An album page tinted from its cover, with Hi-Res and FLAC badges, a Play button and the track list, beside its artist's page
screenshots.caption: Album and artist pages in their cover's colours

screenshots.alt: Search for "rio" finding the artist Ríos de Ámbar, the album Río Lento and its tracks, with the matched letters underlined, beside that album's page
screenshots.caption: Instant search that ignores accents

screenshots.alt: Now Playing at phone width with format badges and synced lyrics, beside the Artists grid with the mini-player above the tabs
screenshots.caption: Synced lyrics, and a mini-player while you browse

screenshots.alt: Three panels: synced lyrics with the current line highlighted, plain lyrics, and an artist picture standing in for a missing cover, each tinted from its image
screenshots.caption: Lyrics from the tags or a .lrc file

screenshots.alt: Three panels: AIMP open with nothing playing, AIMP closed with an Open AIMP button, and an offline banner over a paused cloud track
screenshots.caption: Always clear about what AIMP is doing

settings.title: Library folders
settings.description: Folders with your music, one per line (for example C:\Users\you\Music). Leave empty to use the Windows Music folder. B-Side only reads them; files that are only in the cloud (OneDrive Files On-Demand) are listed by name and never downloaded.
